name: RC-B10-0217/2026 – § 2 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text: 2.Calls for the full and unconditional release of all individuals illegally detained, including Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores, and insists that all recover their full civil and political rights;
